question: What measurements are assigned up to the eye-end and the navel-end?
premises: The measure up to the eye-end is given as one and a half plus two parts.
The measure up to the navel-end is given as one and a half plus three parts.
inference: The eye-end and navel-end are fixed at two-and-a-half and three-and-a-half parts respectively.
uncertainties: puṭāntakam may indicate navel or hip region depending on convention
plain_english: Up to the end of the eyes is two and a half parts, and up to the end of the navel is three and a half parts.
